Assistant: Response: The primary outcome measure used in the study to assess child development is the Early Years Foundation Stage Profile (EYFSP). This profile is used to assess children’s development at the end of their reception year in school (typically ages 4-5). The EYFSP measures children’s development against 17 Early Learning Goals (ELGs), which cover a range of areas including personal, social and emotional development; communication and language; physical development; literacy; mathematics; understanding the world; expressive arts and design. The EYFSP is used by teachers and teaching assistants to assess children’s development, and to identify any children who may need additional support or intervention. The EYFSP is also used by local authorities and the Department for Education to monitor and evaluate the progress of children in their early years of education.
